$comment: The modules of Sovkora, one repository (ADR-029), in build order: what each folder is, its toolchain and what it depends on. Read by the docs generator, the CI plan and the dev tools. A folder that is not here is not a module.

modules.name: build
modules.description: The parent POM sovkora-parent (krizaka-parent from Maven Central, the Spring Boot / Spring AI BOMs, the Sovkora BOM, the ADR-029 naming guards) and the shared governance test kit (ArchUnit rules, Testcontainers base).

modules.name: contracts
modules.description: Tier-1 platform contracts shared by every Sovkora service: the job plane (sovkora-jobs-api), the application-persistence ports (sovkora-persistence-api) and the secret sealing (sovkora-crypto). Pure interfaces and records.

modules.name: studio
modules.description: Studio & pack marketplace: pack catalogue, studio blueprints, installations and saga-driven runs, with its contract (studio-api) and HTTP client (studio-client).

modules.name: engine
modules.description: The Sovkora cognitive SDK: AiClient & provider mesh (core), the interceptor pipeline, tools (MCP · RAG · sandbox), use-case orchestration (business), application persistence and asset encryption, as sovkora-engine-* modules.

modules.name: conversation
modules.description: Interactive ingress of the Sovkora engine: chat (SSE streaming), intents, models, pipeline, MCP and job APIs — translates transport into Intentions, never business logic.

modules.name: job
modules.description: Asynchronous job executor of the Sovkora engine: drains the interactive and batch lanes, owns the capability registry and the worker registry.

modules.name: knowledge
modules.description: Knowledge & RAG retrieval service (pgvector) with asynchronous indexing.

modules.name: automation
modules.description: Connector automation (Jira, Slack, WhatsApp, Messenger, CLI agents) with Quartz scheduling and execution telemetry.

modules.name: edge
modules.description: Transparent HTTP edge in front of every Sovkora service: routing, API-key → JWT exchange, CORS and tracing. Spring MVC + virtual threads.

modules.name: worker-media
modules.description: Native (Metal) Python worker for image/video generation and media composition, speaking the Sovkora AMQP worker protocol.

modules.name: web
modules.description: Next.js (App Router) client of the Sovkora platform with its mandatory BFF.

modules.name: mobile
modules.description: Expo / React Native client of the Sovkora platform (talks to the edge with Bearer tokens).

modules.name: cli
modules.description: The developer CLI: install, start, dev, test, docs and pack tooling for the local Sovkora stack, with an offline SQLite queue.

modules.name: desktop
modules.description: The Sovkora desktop app (Tauri 2, Rust and React): the local runtime, the code workspace and the Mac engines, one signed app.

modules.name: packs
modules.description: Reference packs for the Sovkora Studio marketplace (document validation, media, prospection, real-estate, wellbeing…) and the pack manifest schema.
